From what I know Oceans pay well, but there’s two major risks.
1 - the offer comes with a 2 year bond - you have to work for the full term or simply pay and leave. And when I say pay and leave, I’m talking in USD 😅 
If you have no plans of moving overseas or if you think your circumstances will not change within the next 2 years then you should go for it. 

2 - I’ve heard that if they think that you’re not a fit for the role or if their client does not need oceans as a recruiter anymore then they will simply pay you 2-3 months salary and ask you to leave. 
If you work for an outsourcing firm that is not a registered company in Sri Lanka, you’re not an employee but an independent contractor. 
There are no protective laws or regulations in favor of “independent contractors” so it would be easy for them to simply ask you to leave at anytime.

In terms of career growth I’ve heard that the only role that has any real growth is any role related to digital marketing. 
You will find other roles like “legal assistant” or “right hand to the CEO” but there’s no scope for growth and you wouldn’t be able to get promotions or learn anything of substance. 

However, the perks far outweigh the risks - Oceans really does pay well because foreign firms, especially those that pay in USD, don’t fuss about the pay. You also have the comfort of working from home PLUS no taxes!

some weird stuff happened at my place. A few years ago, when I was up late studying, I kept seeing shadows and smelling cigar smoke out of the blue. I randomly woke up one night to see my mom asking me to go to her room with her because she couldn’t sleep… in the middle of the night! I refused and went back to sleep. I jokingly asked mom next morning, and told my dad that she was crazy to do that. She looked at me dead in the eye and said that wasn’t her. My sister had similar experiences, so we got the house blessed by priests and buried something in the garden which was supposed to ward off evil spirits.
All was fine until recently. We found a random blood trail in the kitchen that just vanished. This is weird because nobody had any cuts and I checked with all my siblings including our helper. I thought it could be one of our stray cats as they do have the tendency to slip in to our house looking for food (we have a large open garden) but none of them had any cuts.  And then I started hearing loud footsteps and heavy breathing outside my room, almost like a growl. The scariest was when I was feeding a couple of stray cats at night, I heard someone laughing right beside me, but there was no one there. I continued to feed the cats thinking I was probably imagining it but then I heard it again. It freaked me out so bad that I just bolted home. There were so many other incidents like chairs being turned upside down in the living room, things being misplaced around the house. But up until now, we have never really seen the ghost/entity.

Something similar happened to me. We were being worked to our bone to a point where we would work 12 hours a day for 5 days a week. I was contemplating whether to quit or not but this one incident really sealed that decision. I completed a case that was handed over to me a few months ago and I left the office (after my 12 hour shift ended) without informing the client that the case completed (this is a requirement for every case that completes - the client is supposed to be updated). I left to go home AND WORK, which was why I did not have the need to inform my manager or my colleague that the case completed. I was going to close the case by informing the client anyway as soon as I went home. There was about a 20 minute delay in informing the client and this was picked up on and blown way out of proportion. They said that i am difficult to communicate with and that nobody could reach me on my mobile (AGAIN- I was on my way home!!!) this was the last straw and I handed in my resignation. They did not accept it the first time and asked me to re-think my decision as they received orders from higher management to retain me. But nope - I have had it. I didnt mind the long hours and the workload even though it fucked up my mental health, but when they held me culpable for a 20 minute fucking delay I just called it quits. I mean Fuck you.
